2607.29287.title: Translation with Thought: Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation
2607.29287.paper_summary: Multi-domain machine translation (MDMT) poses a unique challenge due to varying levels of linguistic complexity across domains. Inspired by human translators' ability to adapt reasoning effort based on difficulty, we propose TwT (Translation with Thought), a resource-rational framework that learns to modulate inference between intuitive and deliberate reasoning. TwT is trained in two stages: (1) supervised fine-tuning on difficulty-aware long chain-of-thought traces distilled from DeepSeek-R1 and rewritten by GPT-4o to reflect human-like reasoning economy, and (2) reinforcement learning with a hybrid reward to optimize translation quality and reasoning efficiency. Evaluated on 15 benchmarks spanning in-domain and out-of-domain settings, as well as 3 seen and 59 unseen languages, with ablations across three backbone models, TwT-7B and TwT-14B outperform much larger SOTA reasoning models in translation quality, while reducing token usage by 32--60\%. These results confirm that aligning translation behavior with cognitive principles enables robust generalization, high translation quality, and efficient reasoning in MDMT.
2607.29287.paper_summary_zh: 多領域機器翻譯（MDMT）因各領域語言複雜性的不同而面臨獨特挑戰。受到人類翻譯者根據難度調整推理努力能力的啟發，我們提出了TwT（Translation with Thought），這是一個資源理性的框架，學習在直觀推理和深思熟慮推理之間調節推理。TwT的訓練分為兩個階段：（1）在基於難度的長鏈思維痕跡上進行監督微調，這些痕跡來自DeepSeek-R1，並由GPT-4o重寫以反映類似人類的推理經濟性；（2）使用混合獎勵進行強化學習，以優化翻譯質量和推理效率。在涵蓋領域內和領域外設置的15個基準上進行評估，以及3種已見和59種未見語言，並在三個主幹模型上進行消融實驗，TwT-7B和TwT-14B在翻譯質量上超越了更大規模的SOTA推理模型，同時將標記使用量減少了32--60\%。這些結果確認了將翻譯行為與認知原則對齊能夠實現穩健的泛化、高翻譯質量和在MDMT中的高效推理。
